nodes.title: StudioStage reads the teacher's PiP keep-clear zone LIVE from App's slot element (data-pip-zone, --pip-zone-w/-h/-right/-bottom on [data-stage-slot], App 7472ec30, in int/r6 07185e93), moved into the stage's coordinates and re-read on every change (MutationObserver); the piece is lifted above it or fitted into the room above. Replaces the mirrored copy of App's rule (dc-r7-piece-clear-of-pip). Re-recorded table-* at 412 with the live zone.

md.decisions:
## dc-r7-pip-zone-live: Studio reads the PiP's real position (2026-11-04)

App now publishes where the teacher's picture sits. Studio reads that live, instead of a copy of App's sizing rule, so boards stay clear of it however App lays the stage out.
